description: This file defines a command handler class `ActivateSavingsAccountCommandHandler` used for activating savings accounts within the Fineract project. It implements the `NewCommandSourceHandler` interface, processes activation commands, and delegates the actual activation logic to the `SavingsAccountWritePlatformService`.

classes.name: ActivateSavingsAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring Service class that handles commands to activate savings accounts, annotated with command type metadata, and delegating activation to the associated service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the activation command by delegating to the write platform service to perform the activation based on the supplied JSON command.
